name: Trek
verdict: Trek Bicycle Corporation, a family-owned US bike maker (owned by the employees and the founding family). Nothing found.
note: US bicycle manufacturer, Waterloo, Wisconsin; co-title sponsor (with Lidl) of the Lidl-Trek men's and women's teams and kit supplier sponsor. Rated none: private family/employee ownership, no state stake, and no human-rights finding against Trek was found in this run.
